I've made the mistake of using products with almond oil in my hair before as it seems to be in just about everything, the result was SO much itchiness and irritation of my scalp and skin. After reading the raving reviews on this particular Shea butter I decided to give it a try. Even though the reviews were glowing I still was skeptical. In my mind I'm thinking it's just "Shea butter"

As I already said...I've purchased Shea butter before from other brands and they were ok. Nothing special and they all smelled the same. This is the first brand that I've seen where they have different scented Shea butters!

Saying that I'm IMPRESSED is an understatement !!! The first thing I immediately noticed when I opened the tub was the absolutely sensational scent! I purchased the Lavender scent and I LOOOVVEE it!!! The smell and the insanely smooth texture of this Shea butter is definitely Top Tier! When they say this is Premium Shea butter they mean it! I applied this all over after getting out of the shower and I felt like I'd just went to the Spa! I felt so luxurious and my skin was so incredibly soft!!! I'm officially OBSESSED!! lol

I'm getting ready to purchase two more scents because one tub is not enough! I need to have a tub of this in every bathroom in my house!
